title: perf(data-objectstack)!: an object route reads that object's saved views, not every view of every object
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y _Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSdbhcPy8LxJmPaZb2ECoEq)_ Fixes #29550 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6586963407 · amendments: 6587053002, 6587483534, 6591325082 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:对象页的已保存视图(`listViews`)和视图设置(`listViewOverrides`)不再下载所有对象的全部视图。没有别的读取在加载整张视图列表时,两者合用一次 `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=对象名`(ADR-0017 §3.5)。整张列表已加载或正在加载时,直接从它取,不再发请求。 - 为什么改:控制台创建的应用(无包)打开对象页时,`listViews` 是唯一下载整张 `/meta/view` 的读取。app-crm 上 crm_account 从 7,452 B 降到 395 B,crm_lead 从 7,452 B 降到 3,677 B,请求数不变。有包的应用对象页在 #29609(已合入 main)之后,`listViews` 也是唯一的整表读取;本分支合并 main 后,这些页面同样只发 `?object=`(crm_lead 3,239 B,showcase_project 4,763 B)。 - 风险与回滚:这是收窄。没有 `viewKind` 或顶层 `object` 的旧视图行(#7741 写入门之前存的)不再显示为页签,草稿预览也一样。服务端的按对象读取本来就不返回这种行。app-crm 和 showcase 新部署上没有这种行,控制台今天保存的视图两个字段都有。补救是在控制台里重新保存该视图。视图顺序改为契约顺序(`order`,再 `name`),控制台可见的视图切换器顺序在三个路由上实测不变。回滚方法是 revert 本 PR。 - 先看:`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `readObjectViewRows`(三条路径:已存列表、正在读的列表、按对象读取)和 `objectBoundViewRows`(规则);`cache/MetadataCache.ts` 的 `peekInflight`。 - 两分钟验证:新建一个不带包的应用,放一个对象入口,打开该对象页,在开发者工具 Network 里过滤 `meta/view`:应该只有 `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=<对象名>`,没有不带参数的 `/meta/view`。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes `ObjectView`'s saved-views overlay calls `dataSource.listViews(objectName)` on every object route (`ObjectView.tsx:416`), and its override merge calls `listViewOverrides(objectName)`. Both went through the adapter's private `readViewList()`. It downloaded every view of every object (`GET /api/v1/meta/view`) to keep one object's rows. `ObjectView.tsx` is unchanged. Both readers now go through one private helper, `readObjectViewRows(objectName)` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: | The whole view list (`list:view` in the metadata cache) | What the readers do | |---|---| | stored (Studio, the MetadataProvider, or an earlier read loaded it) | Answer from it. No request. | | on the wire (a packaged app's object scope reads it for out-of-bundle lookup targets, #29551) | Join that read. No request of their own. `MetadataCache.peekInflight` is new. The class is not exported from the package, and the method is absent from `dist/index.d.ts`. | | neither | `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=OBJECT` (ADR-0017 §3.5: "the aggregation query that powers the switcher"). Both readers share it while it is in flight, and its answer is stored for the next read, as the whole list's is. | **Drops (amendment 6591325082).** The one-object answer is stored under a metadata-cache key that names the last invalidation of the whole list (`list:view@N?object=OBJECT`, with `N` from the new `MetadataCache.droppedAt`). Every path that drops the whole list also moves that key: a view write through any door (`invalidateViewKeys`, the client write wrap, the console client's `invalidateCache('list:view')`) and an organization, session or locale switch (`clearCache`). So after a drop, the stored one-object answer no longer answers, a request sent before the drop is detached, and the next read asks again. The key a drop retired is dropped on the next read rather than left to the LRU. Every path keeps the same rows in the same order (`objectBoundViewRows`): the server's rule (`createMetaListAnswer` step 4 in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), which is `viewKind` set, `object` naming the object, sorted by `order` then `name`. A server that ignores `?object=` answers its whole list, and the rule still keeps one object's rows. The draft preview (`listViews(obj, { previewDrafts: true })`) keeps its own `?preview=draft` read and applies the same rule to its rows (amendment 6587483534 (1)). Neither client spells `?object=`. `client.meta.getItems` takes a package, and `MetadataClient`'s list takes a package and an include. So the request is built in the adapter, the way `downloadImportTemplate`'s is: the adapter's origin and auth headers, the client's `Accept-Language`, and `credentials: 'include'`. A non-2xx answer rejects with the server's `status` and ADR-0112 `code`, so `listViews` still degrades to `[]` with a `refused` read warning, and `listViewOverrides` still rejects. `listViews`' and `listViewOverrides`' signatures and answer shapes are unchanged. The private `readViewList()` is removed. ### The narrowing (Clause-②: no (narrowing)) A `view` row with no `viewKind` or no top-level `object` is no longer a saved-view tab or a per-view setting, on the published or the draft path. Before, the client matched on `data.object` or `object`, with or without `viewKind`. Such a row could only be stored before the write door refused unbound rows (#7741), and the server's own one-object read never served it. The remedy is in the changeset: open the view in the Console and save it again. The save writes `object` and `viewKind`. Census (amendment 6587053002 (3)), on fresh `objectstack dev --fresh` deployments at base: - app-crm: 87 objects, 10 view rows. Every object's `?object=` rows equal the rows today's adapter lists (crm_activity 3/3, crm_lead 4/4, crm_opportunity 3/3). No row is dropped. - showcase: 115 objects, 36 view rows across 6 objects. No row is dropped. - Two views saved through the Console's own path (`viewEnvelope` → `MetadataClient.save` as draft → `publishDraft`) are stored with `object` and `viewKind: 'list'`, and both are in the `?object=` answer. ## Tests - New `listViews.objectScopedRead-29550.test.ts` (14). It runs the real adapter and the real `@objectstack/client`; only `fetch` is a recording double, serving the server's rule from rows deliberately out of contract order. - Opening an object route makes one `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=crm_lead` for both readers, and no unscoped `/meta/view`. Tabs come in contract order. - CONTROL: with the whole list loaded, nothing more is asked, and the answers equal the one-object read's. - With the whole list on the wire, both readers join it, with no `?object=` beside it and the same answers. - A second object asks its own `?object=`. - A server that ignores `?object=` still yields one object's rows. - Auth and locale headers are sent. - A 403 keeps each reader's failure contract. - The draft preview makes one `?preview=draft` read, no `?object=`, and applies the same rule (a legacy row is excluded). - A view write (`invalidateViewKeys`), a console-client view write (`invalidateCache('list:view')`) and a switch (`clearCache`) each detach the one-object read in flight, and the read after the drop asks again (3 cases). CONTROL: with nothing dropped, a read in flight is joined. - The one-object answer serves the next read, and a view write or a switch drops it (2 cases). - New `objectViewRoute.test-support.ts`: the server half of `?object=` for the suites that stand a store in for the server. It restates the server's rule rather than importing the adapter's, so a drift between them goes red. - Existing doubles answer `?object=` from the same rows their store holds, and stub clients gained `getLocale` (in `listViews.test.ts`, `listViewOverrides.test.ts`, `listViews.roundTripKeys-11013`, `viewItemObjectName.declaredSpelling-11013`, `viewOverlayMarker`, `viewOverlayMarkerOnly-10210`, `viewOverlayPatchOnly`, and `viewCacheInvalidation.pin`). Fixtures whose subject is not `viewKind` gained `viewKind: 'list'`. App-shell consumer pins (amendment 6591325082). These suites stood a fake store in for the whole `/meta/view` list, so after this change their reads went to an unanswered `?object=`. Every fake server or store now answers `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=` by the server's rule (new test support `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/objectViewRoute.ts`, which restates the rule rather than importing the adapter's). Each card's invariant is kept. Nothing is deleted, skipped or loosened. | Test | Old assertion | New assertion | |---|---|---| | `MetadataProvider.oneMetadataRead-13044` "a view write drops the stored list: the next list read asks again" (both writes) | after the write, `listViews('account')` + `listViewOverrides('contact')`: `/meta/view` asked 2 times | after the write, `listViews('account')` + `listViewOverrides('account')`: `?object=account` asked once (the read after the write asked; the one after it reads what it stored), `/meta/view` still 1 | | `…oneMetadataRead-13044` "a view write detaches the list request in flight" and "a view saved straight through the client detaches…" | the read after the write makes `/meta/view` 2 | the read after the write asks `?object=account` (1); it does not join the whole-list request on the wire (`/meta/view` stays 1) | | `…oneMetadataRead-13044` "a draft-preview list read never fills the stored list" | the published read after it: `/meta/view` 1 | the published read after it: `?object=account` 1, `/meta/view` 0, and `list:view` still not stored | | `MetadataProvider.switchDropsAdapter-13044` "an organization switch detaches a view-list request in flight" | the read after the switch makes `/meta/view` 2 | the read after the switch asks `?object=account` (1); `/meta/view` stays 1 | | `…switchDropsAdapter-13044` "an organization or session switch drops the stored view list" (both switches) | `/meta/view` 2 after the switch | `?object=account` 1 after the switch, `/meta/view` 1, and a second read asks nothing more | | `…switchDropsAdapter-13044` new: "an organization or session switch drops a stored one-object view answer" (both switches) | (new) | a stored `?object=account` answer, then the switch: the next read asks again (`?object=account` 1 → 2) | | `viewListDrop-13057` (all 9 write cases and the controls) | reads counted on `/api/v1/meta/view` exactly | reads counted on `/api/v1/meta/view` with any query (`?object=` included); every number unchanged | | `viewCacheInvalidation.guard` (Publish, create, report-publish control) | `getItems` called 1 / 2 times | reads of the published views (`?object=account` requests plus `getItems` calls) 1 / 2 times; same numbers | | `ObjectView.viewConfigSaveEnvelope-10210` "a re-read still classifies the view as a saved view" | the publish lands through a bare `meta.saveItem` stub | the publish lands through the console's `publishRuntimeMetadata` seam (as `objectViewViewCrud` saves), which drops the object's view keys; assertions unchanged | | `ObjectView.overlayPatchOnly`, `ObjectView.overrideMasquerade` (marked row) | overlay fixtures without `viewKind` | the fixtures carry `viewKind: 'list'`, as the server stores an overlay (inherited at save from the registry entry it shadows, `normalizeViewMetadata`, objectstack#2555). These tests are about the overlay's body and its marker, not about legacy rows. Assertions unchanged. | | `ObjectView.fallbackTabSessionOnly-11643`, `ObjectView.inlineEditSessionOnly-5144`, `InterfaceListPage.hollowOverlayHydration` | (harness only) | the fake store answers `?object=`; assertions unchanged | | `data-objectstack/viewCacheInvalidation.pin` 13057 and `listViewOverrides` key pins | cache keys read: `[]`, and `['view-overrides:account']` | `['list:view@0?object=account', 'list:view@0?object=account']`, and `['view-overrides:account', 'list:view@0?object=account']`: the one-object key, which every invalidation of `list:view` retires | Pin rewrites, authorized by amendment 6587483534: | Test | Old assertion | New assertion | |---|---|---| | `listViews.test.ts` "keeps legacy bare specs without a viewKind" → "a legacy row without a viewKind is not a tab, published or in the draft preview" | `['saved_grid', 'wrapped_grid']` | `[]` on both paths | | `listViews.test.ts` "does NOT exclude a flat legacy saved view with no viewKind at all" → "…is not listed by either read (objectstack#29550)" | `['crm_lead.my_view']` | `[]` on both paths | | `listViews.test.ts` "non-preview mode uses the published getItems path" → "non-preview mode reads the published one-object route" | `getItems` called once, 0 `/meta/view` fetches | `getItems` not called, fetches exactly `['http://test.local/api/v1/meta/view?object=crm_activity']` | | `listViews.test.ts` "a marked row is excluded even without the legacy viewKind signal" → "a marked row is excluded by the marker alone" | marked row (no `viewKind`) excluded | marked row (with `viewKind`) excluded, and an unmarked control row is listed | | `viewCacheInvalidation.pin.test.ts` 13057 case | `getItems` called 2 times with `'view'` | two `?object=account` fetches, `getItems` not called, and a held list answers with no third request | ## Acceptance notes - **A whole-list read already on the wire is joined.** Before #29609, on a packaged app's object route the unscoped `/meta/view` was the app object scope's read for lookup targets outside the bundle (#29551). At base, `listViews` joined it through the shared `list:view` entry. A first cut that always asked `?object=` put one request more beside it (+3,677 B on crm_lead, +5,249 B on showcase_project). Joining the read already on the wire fixed that, and an ablation of the join goes red. #29609 landed first. This branch merged main at `dfc9107d` and re-measured crm_app: `?object=` is all these routes ask (see Verification). - **Order.** The adapter's answer follows the contract order (`order`, then `name`). The Console's visible view switcher sorts on its own (`ObjectView`'s `viewList.sort`: the user's order, then `sortOrder`, then declared order), and on the three measured routes it is unchanged (see Verification). - **The URL** uses the fixed `/api/v1/meta` prefix, as `MetadataClient` does. - **A write or a switch while the one-object read is in flight** detaches it, as it detaches the whole-list read (amendment 6591325082). A reader that joined it before the write gets the pre-write rows, the same window the whole-list share has. - The adapter's `createView` does not stamp `viewKind`. No production caller uses it: the Console saves through `viewEnvelope`, which writes both fields. - `appObjectScope.ts`, `AppContent.tsx` and `ObjectView.tsx` are not touched. The app bundle is not used as a source: a new saved view does not mark it stale, and it does not cover objects outside the app. ## Verification Production Console (`pnpm console:build`), served by `objectstack dev --fresh` (app-crm on one server, showcase on another). Playwright signs in, opens each route, then reloads with the cache disabled and logs every `/api/` request with its CDP initiator stack (`Debugger.setAsyncCallStackDepth 64`), as #29416 measured. The view list on app-crm is 7,452 B here (#29416 measured 7,014 B) because two views were saved on `crm_lead` through the Console's path for the order check. Raw results and the scripts are in the project folder `issue-29550/measure/`. **1. A console-created (package-less) app's object route: the card's case.** Runtime app `ops_app`, saved through `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/ops_app` with entries for `crm_account` and `crm_lead`. Before is the base adapter (`dbca3ef0`), after is this head. | Route | Before | After | |---|---|---| | `/apps/ops_app/crm_account` | 33 requests, 368,178 B. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` 7,452 B, initiator `listViews` → `readViewList` → `getItems` | 33 requests, 361,121 B. `GET /api/v1/meta/view?object=crm_account` 395 B, initiator `listViews` → `readObjectViewRows` → `requestObjectViewRows`. No unscoped `/meta/view`. | | `/apps/ops_app/crm_lead` | 33 requests, 368,977 B. `/meta/view` 7,452 B, same initiator | 33 requests, 365,202 B. `?object=crm_lead` 3,677 B. No unscoped `/meta/view`. | **2. A packaged app's object route, with #29551's fix (#29609, now on main).** Same server data in both columns. Before is #29609's head `fadf5b2f` alone. After is this branch with #29609 merged. | Route | #29609 alone | #29609 + this PR | |---|---|---| | `crm_app/crm_lead` | `/meta/view` 7,452 B, initiator `listViews` → `readViewList` (the only reader left) | `?object=crm_lead` 3,677 B. No unscoped `/meta/view`. | | `crm_app/crm_account` | `/meta/view` 7,452 B, same | `?object=crm_account` 395 B | | `showcase_app/showcase_project` | `/meta/view` 24,867 B, same | `?object=showcase_project` 5,249 B | **3. Re-measured at the final head `dfc9107d`** (main merged, #29609 included), on fresh servers (no extra saved views). Every route asks one `?object=` read from `listViews` → `readObjectViewRows` → `requestObjectViewRows`, and none asks an unscoped `/meta/view`: - `crm_app/crm_lead`: 28 requests, `?object=crm_lead` 3,239 B. - `crm_app/crm_account`: 28 requests, `?object=crm_account` 395 B. - `ops_app/crm_account`: 33 requests, 395 B. - `ops_app/crm_lead`: 33 requests, 3,239 B. - `showcase_project`: 29 requests, `?object=showcase_project` 4,763 B. Before #29609 landed, on a packaged route the unscoped read was the app object scope's, and the readers joined it. Request counts were then equal to base (28, 28 and 29), with no `?object=` beside it. **Tab order (amendment 6587053002 (2)).** Two views were saved through the Console's path, "Zeta board" first and then "Alpha grid". | Object | `listViews` before (the whole list's order) | `listViews` after (contract order; the same from the stored list) | |---|---|---| | app-crm `crm_lead` | all, pipeline, zeta_board, alpha_grid | all, alpha_grid, zeta_board, pipeline | | showcase `showcase_project` | by_status, budget_chart, default, zeta_board, alpha_grid | alpha_grid, by_status, zeta_board, budget_chart, default | The Console's visible view switcher sorts on its own and is unchanged before and after, read from the open switcher: - `crm_app/crm_lead`: All Leads, Lead Pipeline (Kanban), Zeta board, Alpha grid. - `showcase_project`: All Projects, By Status, Budget by Account, Zeta board, Alpha grid. The order is the same at `e2b1fef3`, with #29609 merged, and on `ops_app/crm_lead`.
Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with git diff HEAD empty) At `e2b1fef3`: - `listViews` reads `client.meta.getItems('view')` again: 5 of 8 red in the new file. - `listViewOverrides` reads `client.meta.getItems('view')` again: 4 of 8 red. - The in-flight join removed (`if (listing && false)`): the join case red (1 of 8). At `1ed9b5c3` (amendment 6591325082): - The one-object key no longer names the last drop (`list:view@0?object=`): 6 red. That is `viewCacheInvalidation.guard` (Publish click, create), the new file (two detach cases, the stored-answer drop) and `ObjectView.viewConfigSaveEnvelope-10210` (re-read after the publish). - An earlier cut that detached in-flight reads only, joining whatever was on the wire: the three detach cases red.
Local runs At the final head `c9e08a02` (main merged): - Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 36 commands, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). `check-sdui-manifest` is among them. - Every app-shell test file that names `listViews`, `listViewOverrides` or `/meta/view`: 140 files, 1,154 tests, all passed (under `os-verify-lock`, `--maxWorkers=2`). - `@object-ui/data-objectstack` full suite: 113 files, 1,291 tests, all passed. `type-check` exit 0. - `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (sources and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, at `1ed9b5c3`. - Full dogfood battery (narrowing arm), closure built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock`: Tests 3,308 passed and 17 skipped (3,325); Test Files 400 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed (402), VERDICT command-exit 1. The failed file is `print-service-render.dogfood.test.ts`, at its `afterAll` cleanup, not at a test. `rmSync` of the Chromium profile dir raised `ENOTEMPTY` (`/tmp/os-print-render-remote-*/Default`) after all 8 tests passed. Re-run alone under the lock, the file passes (8/8, VERDICT command-exit 0). It reads no adapter or app-shell code. At `e2b1fef3` (main merged at `a81b625f`): - `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: no error on a changed line. Four pre-existing `no-console` hits at `index.ts:2041-2061` are inline-disabled on main. - Full dogfood battery: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 400 passed and 1 skipped (401), Tests 3,291 passed and 17 skipped (3,308).
